job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our team at VIKISOL TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED. The ideal candidate will have expertise in developing and implementing artificial intelligence and machine learning models, with a strong focus on generative techniques.


Roles and Responsibility

Design and develop scalable and efficient generative AI models.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop and implement data augmentation strategies to enhance model performance.
Conduct research and stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.
Optimize model performance using hyperparameter tuning and other techniques.
Work closely with data engineers to ensure seamless data pipelines.


Job Requirements

Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
